card.name: Words just before an expected effect verb
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "to" after "has been shown" or "reported", and adverbs like "completely" or "otherwise", where a verb about an effect (prevent, reverse, delay, occur) comes next. Also fires partway through a few drug names.

modes.label: to after shown/reported
modes.description: The word "to" after "has been shown" or "has been reported" in drug-effect statements.
modes.example: has been shown<< to>> be effective in lowering blood pressure.

modes.label: Adverb before a verb
modes.description: An adverb or linking word that sits before an effect verb in an interaction or warning sentence.

modes.description: A piece in the middle of a radiopharmaceutical name.

card.writes: It leans toward outputting forms of "normalize", which suggests the next word describes an effect being reversed or corrected.
card.plain: It marks the spot just before a verb saying what a drug does or reverses, such as after "has been shown to".
